tranche_rule: D-41 (verbatim): "Texture-complete" - the Phase 3/4 split criterion - is the repository already containing the creature approved art (a corresponding .png in the KelpCurtain creature asset tree), not a design-row checkbox or inline design . Research proved evidence/biology.xml carries no per-creature texture checkbox and that the only per-creature artwork marker is an inline . D-42 (verbatim): Creatures that have repository art but no design artwork marker (e.g. 荆棘苔龟, 格普螺, 叶飞棍) are in Phase 3. The repository-art-vs-design-art discrepancy is recorded in 03-DEVIATIONS.md for later designer confirmation, not treated as out-of-scope. Enumerated with Get-ChildItem -Recurse Sources/Modules/Yggdrasil/KelpCurtain/NPCs -File -Filter *.png: MossyThornTurtle.png, GuppyConch.png, VerdantRods.png, GiantDandelion.png, RiverSlug.png and AcroporaSnake.png (the last is the boss art consumed by Phase 7). This CRITICAL_OVERRIDE supersedes 03-RESEARCH.md Finding 1 / Open Question 1, which proposed an inline design- proxy.
naming_rule: A new creature class takes its class name and internal name from the existing repository art basename (MossyThornTurtle.png -> MossyThornTurtle), keeping the tML default texture resolution working with no Texture override, no handwritten asset path and no asset move. Never place a ModNPC class in a subfolder of NPCs/ for a creature whose approved art sits directly in NPCs/. No asset is created, moved or renamed.

assumptions: tranche rule (03-DEVIATIONS.md section 1): D-41/D-42 - texture-complete is the repository already containing the creature approved .png, not a design-row checkbox or inline design ; the five phase:3 rows are 水蛞蝓, 荆棘苔龟, 格普螺, 叶飞棍 and 巨树人, and the six design-art-only creatures fall to Phase 4

repository-art vs design-art discrepancy (section 2): design_art (the design source inline marker) is independent of texture_complete, the two flags disagree on this snapshot, and the discrepancy is recorded for designer confirmation rather than treated as out of scope

mapping assumptions (section 3): every repository asset is mapped to a design row by name, description and geometry inference, and every name_en except 荆棘苔龟 is executor-supplied; the mappings are recorded for designer confirmation, not treated as design statements

conservative defaults (section 4): where the design is silent or gives a difficulty progression, the recorded conservative default is used - spawn weights, sprite-derived hit boxes, the 1:1 copper NPC.value transpose, NPC.rarity read from the empty 稀有度 cell, and the D-31 aiStyle choice

drop availability (section 5): Phase 3 consumes Phases 1-2 item scope only - five item types are wired (ThornTurtleShell, GuppyShell, ArmOfGiantTree, HardenedWitherbarkHeart, BoulderCatapult) and four designed materials stay absent blockers (软体甲壳碎片, 飞棍毛发, 毒腺, 枯木碎块) with no type reference written (D-37/D-39)

spawn-region gap (section 6): no 森雨幽谷 or 刺苔庭园 biome predicate exists yet, so spawn gating uses the server-safe layer-level KelpCurtainBiome.IsKelpCurtainLayer plus SubworldSystem.IsActive<YggdrasilWorld>(), and the per-region refinement is a Phase 5-6 terrain blocker (D-30)
deviations: plan API-name corrections (Rule 1): the plan prose's spawnInfo.player and NPC.rare do not exist in this tModLoader version and were corrected to NPCSpawnInfo.Player and NPC.rarity; applied by plans 03-01 and 03-03 and compile-verified by the Release build

plan 03-02 (Rule 2): the 格普螺 shell-state transition lives in HitEffect rather than ModifyIncomingHit, because tML documents ModifyIncomingHit as modifiers-only with side effects belonging to the OnHit hooks; ModifyIncomingHit keeps the design's 0.85/0.70 FinalDamage scales

D-23: RiverSlug is a pre-existing accepted implementation that Phase 3 does not modify; its HitEffect dust is not Main.dedServ-guarded and the gate's preExistingAllowlist exempts it from the Phase 3 structural guards

the two 巨树人 attack projectiles request only the shared Commons.ModAsset.White_Mod fallback because no approved art exists and creating placeholder art is forbidden; the missing ground-wave and boulder sprites are a named blocker (section 9)
absent designed drops stay absent: 格普螺's 软体甲壳碎片 and 叶飞棍's 飞棍毛发/毒腺 produce no type reference at all, so 格普螺's loot table is partial and 叶飞棍's is deliberately empty (D-37/D-39)
plan 03-03 staged the two projectile spawns as clearly-marked compile-safe seams in Task 1 and filled them in Task 2; no seam marker remains, so the intermediate state is not unfinished work
